title: "Guinea forest monitoring"
subtitle: "Methodology review for measuring forest and deforestation in Guinea"

This site collects the analyses carried out to design a national method for measuring forest area and forest loss in
Guinea from satellite data.

## Reports

[**Forest loss in Guinea from global satellite products**](forest_loss_assessment.qmd)
: Stage 1 assessment. Reviews Hansen Global Forest Change (forest definition, the 2013 break in its series, where and
  how concentrated forest loss is) and compares it with six global forest and land-cover maps on a common sample of
  56,712 points.
